svg.title: About José Rodriguez
svg.desc: Tech Lead and Senior Full Stack AI Engineer with 8+ years building web and mobile products end to end. I design AI-native development workflows (AI agents, MCP, RAG and spec-driven development) on top of solid backend architecture, cloud and team leadership. Tech Lead at Blackstone Studio: Owning delivery of web and mobile products, from spec to production. AI-native workflows in production: Multi-agent systems, Skills, MCP, RAG and spec-driven development. 30+ products shipped: Web and mobile platforms delivered end to end for real clients. Teams of up to 8: Developers, design and QA, working with agile delivery. 40+ students mentored: Mentor in Full Stack JavaScript bootcamps. Clean Architecture, DDD, SOLID: Systems designed to keep changing for years.
